title: PGR + Fert, Fairways (remainder, JD)
last_load: Quinstar + Firepower, Rough, Mon 9 Nov. The JD must be decontaminated before this mix goes in
site_check: Spray signs out at the fairways you're on
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind under 15 km/h · gusts under 30
facts: JD HD200 · Tan Wilger (SR110-20) · 9.8 km/h · 3.8 bar
extra_checks: JD decontaminated after Monday's Firepower tank
Tank cleaner, then triple rinse through tank, boom, filters and nozzles. Firepower kills couch: if it hasn't been done, don't fill. Call Andy
Section control on, fairway boundaries loaded
Boom off on tees, greens, surrounds and bunkers
Enough for the tanks you need
Each tank: 1.95 L Shadow, 1.5 L Ambient Plus, 30 L GreenMaxx, 37.5 kg iron sulphate
ppe_note: Iron sulphate and GreenMaxx are acidic and stain: goggles, elbow gloves and apron, dust mask when you tip the bags. Ambient Plus can cause serious eye damage: goggles.
spray_rules: Remainder of fairways (not the ones done Monday), 1.5 ha a tank. Mix another tank on the page each time you refill
The 5800 is on fairways too: agree who does which holes before you start
Keep the speed steady at 9.8 km/h. Turn the boom off on tees, greens, surrounds and bunkers
Avoid spraying near golf. Work in the gaps behind groups
Start once Delta T is over 2. Stop if it gusts over 30 or blows off target
Keep people off each fairway until it's dry. Hose any iron sulphate splashes off paths and concrete straight away: it stains
spray_more: Shadow Ultra label: common couch fairways 0.8–1.6 L/ha in 100–500 L/ha water, no rain or irrigation within 1 h, no entry without protective clothing until dry. Ambient Plus label: shake before use, at least 420 L/ha water. Iron sulphate stains concrete, paths and paintwork.
post_checks: Number of tanks and fairways done written in GreenKeeper

flags.t: Decontaminate the JD before this mix goes in
flags.d: Monday's JD tank was Quinstar + Firepower on the rough. Firepower (haloxyfop) kills couch at very low doses, so a plain water rinse isn't enough before a couch fairway tank: tank cleaner, then a triple rinse through tank, boom, filters and nozzles. It's the first check on the rig list.

flags.t: Ambient Plus: check the shelf before you fill
flags.d: GreenKeeper had 7.0 L on hand before Monday's fairway tanks were entered. Each 5800 tank takes 2.4 L and each JD tank 1.5 L, so Monday's tanks may have used most of it. If there isn't enough for the tank, call Andy before you fill.
The 5800 and the JD are both on fairways with the same mix. Agree who does which holes before you start, so nothing gets missed or double-sprayed.

Label for golf fairways: common couch 0.8–1.6 L/ha, couch varieties such as Santa Ana and Wintergreen 0.6–1.2 L/ha, kikuyu 1.6–4 L/ha. 1.3 L/ha is inside the common couch range and just over the top of the hybrid couch range. 500 L/ha is the top of its 100–500 L/ha water volume.

Iron sulphate at 25 kg/ha is about 5 kg Fe/ha (20% Fe), plus about 1.2 kg Fe/ha from the GreenMaxx (6% Fe). Tuesday's forecast max is 25 °C, warmer than Monday's 22 °C: an early finish keeps the blackening risk down. Add the iron slowly with the agitator running.
flags.s: Iron sulphate SDS · GreenMaxx SDS · GreenKeeper forecast 10 Nov

flags.t: Ambient Plus in an acidic tank
flags.d: Its label says it can be tank mixed with any spray; its SDS lists strong acids as incompatible for the concentrate. It goes in before the iron and GreenMaxx, as the sheet has it. 1.0 L/ha is just under its 1.2 L/ha label rate.
